If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

I split the `HoursBySite` chart into one series per equipment type. The series are now generated at render time from the distinct values of `Fields!EquipmentType.Value`, so new types appear without any report change.

The existing `OperatingHours` series is now the template for each generated series. It still plots `Sum(OperatingHours)` by site, using the same column type. The categories are still sites, so each site will show one column per equipment type, side by side. I haven't previewed the report, so I can't confirm how many series a given run produces.

The validator passes. Its remaining warnings were already there: two unused data sources, two date-like parameters typed as String, and an orphan `Utilization` field in DataSet1. I didn't change any of those.
